blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Even if the proposed Code of Conduct (COC) in the South China Sea remains unfinished, a ranking House of Representatives lawmaker believes the current administration still deserves praise for speeding up the process — from 50 percent completion to 80 percent in a year’s time. In a statement on Monday, Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s administration can be credited with its “sustained diplomatic engagement,” which accelerated discussions on the proposed COC. Ortega’s remarks came after Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro admitted on Sunday that while the COC is now at around 80 […]...
